name: oh-story-claudecode
tagline_zh: 从扫榜到拆文，从码字到去AI味，连封面都包了。内置「爆款节奏卡」，让卡文的你直接抄作业。
tagline_en: From trend-scouting to de-AI-ing, even covers done. Built-in beat cards for when you're stuck—just copy the pros.
desc_en: 网文/小说写作 skill 包，覆盖长篇与短篇网络小说的扫榜、拆文、写作、去AI味、封面图全流程
why_zh: 别家只给模板，它把「拆书」变成可复用的节奏卡，连封面提示词都备好，一套流程走完。
why_en: Others give templates; this turns story breakdowns into reusable beat cards, even cover prompts—full pipeline in one.
